description: Renew with shares (§9.4). The writer expires at +300 s; epoch 2 is introduced at +400 s and sealed to the vault only; the renew at +450 s extends the expiry to +7200 s and its `shares` seal epoch 2 to the writer. The writer opens epoch 2 through the renew's share. A record created at +400 s (after the old expiry, before the renewed one) is admitted: the latest verified expiry decides (§11.5 step 2); one created at +10000 s is refused expired.
